page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput networking requirements. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants.

Given its high core count and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c7.32xlarge is structured for compute-heavy workloads. It is suitable for tasks such as high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive web serving, and distributed analytics where processing power is prioritized over large memory footprints.
